introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Further Mathematics Paper 2 (0775), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2023. Time allowed: three hours.**

Answer ALL 10 questions. For your guidance, the approximate mark allocation for parts of each question is indicated. Mathematical formulae and tables published by the Board, and noiseless non-programmable electronic calculators are allowed. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage.

questions.enonce_markdown: Use the substitution $u = x + 2$, or otherwise, to express $f(x)$ in partial fractions. (4 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
Put $u = x + 2$, so $x = u - 2$. The numerator becomes
$$3(u - 2)^{2} + 10(u - 2) + 9 = 3u^{2} - 12u + 12 + 10u - 20 + 9 = 3u^{2} - 2u + 1.$$
Therefore
$$f(x) = \frac{3u^{2} - 2u + 1}{u^{4}} = \frac{3}{u^{2}} - \frac{2}{u^{3}} + \frac{1}{u^{4}}.$$
Returning to $x$:
$$\boxed{f(x) = \frac{3}{(x + 2)^{2}} - \frac{2}{(x + 2)^{3}} + \frac{1}{(x + 2)^{4}}}$$
(There is no term in $\dfrac{1}{x + 2}$: its coefficient is $0$.)

Check at $x = 0$: $f(0) = \dfrac{9}{16}$, and $\dfrac34 - \dfrac28 + \dfrac1{16} = \dfrac{12 - 4 + 1}{16} = \dfrac{9}{16}$, which agrees.

Use the partial fractions of part (a). When $x$ runs from $-1$ to $0$, $u = x + 2$ runs from $1$ to $2$ (and $x \neq -2$ is never reached), so
$$\int_{-1}^{0} f(x)\,dx = \int_{1}^{2}\left(3u^{-2} - 2u^{-3} + u^{-4}\right)du
= \left[-\frac{3}{u} + \frac{1}{u^{2}} - \frac{1}{3u^{3}}\right]_{1}^{2}.$$
At $u = 2$: $-\dfrac32 + \dfrac14 - \dfrac1{24} = \dfrac{-36 + 6 - 1}{24} = -\dfrac{31}{24}$.

At $u = 1$: $-3 + 1 - \dfrac13 = -\dfrac73 = -\dfrac{56}{24}$.

Subtracting:
$$-\frac{31}{24} - \left(-\frac{56}{24}\right) = \frac{25}{24}. \qquad\blacksquare$$
